common.waitsForPrivacy: Read once the page has said what it shows.

privacy.failed: We couldn't read what this site lets you see
privacy.failedBody: Nothing else is read until it is said. Try again.
privacy.pickSite: Choose a site in the top bar
privacy.pickSiteBody: The privacy rules and the legal basis are the site's: nothing is read for all sites at once.
privacy.gateOff: Nobody sees one person's figures at this site: no legal basis is recorded
privacy.youOnRequest: You may open one person's figures on request; each opening is recorded
privacy.workerHr: The worker and HR see one person's figures on request; each opening is recorded
privacy.lines_one: You see lines and operations. A group of fewer than {count} person shows “—”: too few people to show without identifying them.
privacy.lines_other: You see lines and operations. A group of fewer than {count} people shows “—”: too few people to show without identifying them.
privacy.hrOpen: HR: one person on request, with a purpose; the opening is recorded and visible to HR and the DPO.
privacy.hrClosed: One person: not at this site. Until a legal basis is recorded here (union agreement or labour inspectorate authorisation), the page cannot show any person at all.
privacy.worker: Worker: their own figures on the floor, in My day.

tileHint.offStandard: Coded, so not blamed on people

tiles.nothingBefore: Nothing to compare: no line shown between {from} and {to}.

notes.attendanceOff: Attended minutes are not shown: this site's attendance purpose is off (Statuto dei Lavoratori art. 4 c.2). Earned minutes still count.
notes.provisional: Attended minutes are provisional: some attendance days are not approved yet.
notes.hiddenLines_one: {count} line with too few people is left out of the totals too: a total would give it away.
notes.hiddenLines_other: {count} lines with too few people are left out of the totals too: a total would give them away.
notes.traineeDays_one: {count} trainee day is left out on both sides of the line figures.
notes.traineeDays_other: {count} trainee days are left out on both sides of the line figures.

formula.line: Line efficiency = earned minutes ÷ attended minutes.
formula.onStandard: On-standard efficiency = earned minutes ÷ minutes on standard work (attended less coded off-standard and indirect minutes).
formula.planned: Planned efficiency = earned minutes ÷ the planned shift minutes of the people on the line.
formula.earned: Earned minutes = good pieces of the standing reports × the operation's standard minutes on the work order.
formula.actual: Actual minutes per piece = person-minutes of the closed stretches ÷ pieces reported; pauses are left out.

source.standards: The standards of each routing revision

exclusion.trainees: Trainee days: on both sides of the line figures. Bundles a trainee worked on: from the operations.
exclusion.oneTap: One-tap reports: they have no timing, so they count as earned minutes and not as actual minutes.
exclusion.offStandard: Off-standard codes: rejected blocks are left out; the rest come off the minutes on standard work.
exclusion.outside: Work done outside: a report of a subcontract receipt.
exclusion.groups: Any group under the minimum size, also from the totals.

trend.hint: One chart per line against its target; never one series per person. A day with too few people is a gap, not a zero.
trend.noTarget: No target set for this line in Planning.
trend.failed: We couldn't read the lines over time
trend.noAttendance: No line efficiency without attended minutes
trend.empty: No line worked in this period.

tooFew.long: Too few people to show without identifying them.
tooFew.settings: Minimum group size in People settings
tooFew.why: A group smaller than the minimum would show one person's work, so it stays hidden everywhere.

operations.spark: Difference from the standard per day, {operation}
operations.tableLabel: Planned against actual minutes by operation
operations.empty: No timed operations in this period.
operations.trainees_one: {count} bundle a trainee worked on is not counted.
operations.trainees_other: {count} bundles a trainee worked on are not counted.
operations.untimed_one: {count} one-tap report has no timing, so it is not in the actual minutes.
operations.untimed_other: {count} one-tap reports have no timing, so they are not in the actual minutes.
operations.rule: Review: more than {percent} % off the standard, in either direction, over at least {bundles} bundles.

review.leftOut_one: {count} operation off its standard is left out
review.leftOut_other: {count} operations off their standard are left out
review.leftOutMost: Too few people worked on them to show without identifying them: with one person per operation that can be most of the queue, so this list is not the whole picture. It is the cost of the rule (Statuto dei Lavoratori art. 4): those operations can only be reviewed once more people work on them, or with a lower minimum group size.
review.leftOutSome: Too few people worked on them to show without identifying them.
review.failed: We couldn't read the review queue
review.emptyLeftOut: Nothing that can be shown: see what is left out above.
review.rule: More than {percent} % off the standard, in either direction, over at least {bundles} bundles of the last {days} days.
review.title: Standard review
review.changeNote: This records what the standard should become. It changes with a new routing revision in Products, and rates follow only as the law allows.
review.lawPlain: Piece rates change only when working conditions change, and after notice.
review.startRevision: Start the new revision in Products

done.KEEP: Kept: the standard stays and the operation leaves the queue.
done.CHANGE: Recorded. The standard itself changes with a new revision.
done.INVESTIGATE: Recorded: it stays on the queue until someone decides.

sent.done_one: {count} operation sent to the standard review.
sent.done_other: {count} operations sent to the standard review.

held.noReview: Your role may not decide the standard review.
held.pickDecision: Choose Keep, Change or Investigate first.
held.proposed: Say the new standard in minutes per piece, for example 1,25.
held.reason: Say why: a decision about a standard is kept with its reason.
held.oneAtATime: Its figures are hidden: open it and decide on its own.

refused.gatePerformance: The site's legal basis for one person's figures is off, so nothing was shown or recorded.
refused.gateAttendance: This site's attendance purpose is off.
refused.notAllowed: One person's efficiency is seen only by the worker and by HR (Statuto dei Lavoratori art. 4).
refused.REVIEW_MOVED: Someone decided about this operation after you opened it. It has been read again: check it, then decide.
refused.TOO_FEW_PEOPLE: Too few people worked on this operation to review it without identifying them.
refused.STATION_SITE: At this site the floor records name stations, not people: there is no one person's figure.
refused.reason: Say why you open this person's figures.
refused.range: Choose a shorter period: at most {days} days.

individual.gateOff: Not at this site: no legal basis is recorded here (Statuto dei Lavoratori art. 4 c.1), so no person can be shown, looked up or chosen.
individual.notYours: One person's figures are seen only by the worker and by HR, so there is nobody to choose here.
individual.available: Opened one person at a time, with a purpose. No comparison with others, no export, no print.

person.recorded: This view is recorded and visible to HR and the DPO
person.empty: No solo timed work in this period
person.denominator: Efficiency here is earned ÷ the person's own timed minutes, not attended minutes: attendance is kept for attendance.
person.sharedReports_one: {count} report shared with others left out.
person.sharedReports_other: {count} reports shared with others left out.
person.noExport: No comparison, no export, no print. Closing this window forgets the figures.
person.noRegister: You can't choose a person here

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.moves: next and previous operation in the review

arrange.title: Arrange Efficiency
arrange.hint: Ticked sections show, in this order. What you see here stays first.

print.title: Line report
print.privacy: Line totals only. No person is named or counted here.
